source: RDI Scheme — Sectors, Sub-sectors and Types of Projects (revised). Dept of Science & Technology / ANRF.
note: 5 sunrise sectors, 44 sub-sectors, plus 2 catch-all 'other' categories. Project lists are the scheme's own indicative wording, lightly normalised.
